findings.title: Reference schema rejects valid lazy context detail and makes repaired history A fail
findings.trigger: assertHistoryFacts calls conversationContextResponseSchema.parse(detail) on actual GET /api/conversations/:id/contexts/:contextId body. The named schema is a context-reference consumer and its referenceBase requires executionInputId and executionInputDigest. ConversationContextDetail type (conversation-context.ts:38-53) omits those. Both retained actual detail responses have neither field. Candidate af51 changes only context history store and its test, not lazy detail shape.
findings.impact: A reaches successful history then rejects valid detail for missing reference fields; both cases can never pass on the approved backend. The new shared reuse helper also rejects any valid A evidence. Source-inferred deterministic mismatch backed by old real response shape, not a new actual runtime failure.
findings.required: Use the actual existing detail contract to validate body identity/order/ref/body correspondence; do not augment raw with invented execution IDs or modify shared contracts. Keep exact required history unknown-material/null-digest/execution-digest assertions. Minimum original-scope fix, new fixed SHA and history-contract hash before A.
findings.evidence: Old raw wire.json SHA 518256c57ea810d85bf633f938ca1744007ebda0be596aeb7d70bd3cda49bb82 contains two GET detail bodies with id,conversationId,projectId,contextDigest,createdAt,templateVersion,order,attachments,sources only.
